sloka: देवान्तकः समादाय परिघं वज्रभूषणम्।परिगृह्य गिरीं दोर्भ्यां वपुर्विष्णोर्विडम्बयन् ।। ६.६९.३१ ।।
transliteration: devāntakaḥ samādāya parighaṁ vajrabhūṣaṇam।parigṛhya girīṁ dorbhyāṁ vapurviṣṇorviḍambayan ।। 6.69.31 ।।

translations.english: Devanthaka, holding a bar encrusted with diamonds in both hands, seemed like Vishnu in disguise with a mountain (to churn the milky ocean).
